2608.03579.title: Pin Once, Swap Light: Subspace-Aligned Centroid-Residual Training for Efficient Ultra-LoRA Serving
2608.03579.paper_summary: Modern multi-tenant Low-Rank Adapters (LoRAs) serving systems concurrently host tens to hundreds of LoRA adapters. Though powerful, this introduces a critical system dilemma between serving efficiency and task performance: higher-rank adapters generally achieve better downstream task performance, but their GPU VRAM footprint and Host-to-Device PCIe swapping overhead severely constrain scalability. Conversely, ultra-low-rank adapters ($r \le 2$) minimize both VRAM footprint and PCIe transfer overhead, but suffer from downstream task performance degradation. To solve this problem, we propose Subspace-Aligned LoRA Training (SALT), a serving efficiency-aware hierarchical fine-tuning framework. Our solution operates in three phases. First, a provider jointly trains high-capacity domain centroids on public data within the domain using a novel alignment regularizer that coheres in-domain task subspaces into a unified basis. Next, users fine-tune ultra-low-rank task residual adapters on private data atop those frozen centroids. Finally, during inference, the provider pins the centroid in GPU VRAM and dynamically swaps in each user's task residual on demand. Across LLMs of varying scales, SALT recovers high-rank accuracy using $r \le 2$ residuals, achieving up to 18.5% absolute accuracy gains over state-of-the-art compression baselines and reducing per-adapter memory by up to 16x. When integrated into vLLM, SALT improves serving throughput by up to 51% under PCIe bandwidth pressure and 28% under GPU VRAM constraints for Llama-3.2-3B.
2608.03579.paper_summary_zh: 現代多租戶低秩適配器（LoRAs）服務系統同時承載數十到數百個LoRA適配器。雖然功能強大，但這引入了一個關鍵的系統困境，即服務效率與任務性能之間的平衡：較高秩的適配器通常能實現更好的下游任務性能，但其GPU VRAM佔用和主機到設備的PCIe交換開銷嚴重限制了可擴展性。相反，超低秩適配器（$r \le 2$）在最小化VRAM佔用和PCIe傳輸開銷方面表現出色，但卻遭遇下游任務性能的下降。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了子空間對齊LoRA訓練（SALT），這是一個關注服務效率的分層微調框架。我們的解決方案分為三個階段。首先，提供者在該領域的公共數據上共同訓練高容量的領域中心，使用一種新穎的對齊正則化器，將領域內任務子空間整合成一個統一的基礎。接下來，使用者在這些凍結的中心上，基於私有數據微調超低秩的任務殘差適配器。最後，在推理過程中，提供者將中心固定在GPU VRAM中，並根據需求動態交換每個使用者的任務殘差。在不同規模的LLM中，SALT使用$r \le 2$的殘差恢復高秩準確度，與最先進的壓縮基準相比，實現高達18.5%的絕對準確度增益，並將每個適配器的內存減少高達16倍。當整合到vLLM中時，SALT在PCIe帶寬壓力下提升了高達51%的服務吞吐量，在GPU VRAM限制下提升了28%對於Llama-3.2-3B的性能。
